notes:
### Fixed
- **P&L scoped to the connected MT5 account.** Connecting a fresh demo account previously surfaced the previous account's P&L on the dashboard (a tester saw +£2,500 of phantom profit). Two leaks fixed: (a) `trade_logs` had no per-account column so any aggregation over a user's history merged trades from every account they had ever connected, and (b) the in-memory `daily` dict was reset only on date rollover — switching accounts mid-session inherited the prior account's `bot_pnl` / `manual_pnl`. The dashboard now displays only the connected account's trades, and the connected MT5 login is shown in the Bridge panel so it's obvious which account you're looking at.

### Migrations
- `13_add_account_number_to_trade_logs` — non-destructive `ALTER TABLE trade_logs ADD COLUMN account_number INTEGER` plus index `idx_trade_logs_user_account_created`. Pre-V13 rows stay NULL (account unknown); they still enrich a deal whose ticket genuinely belongs to the connected account, because `mt5.history_deals_get` is broker-API-scoped on the read side.

### Engine
- New `_current_account_number` cache + `_on_account_connected(login)` switch detector. Both broker-adapter and direct-MT5 connect paths call it before stamping `daily.start_balance`, so a switch zeroes the in-memory P&L counters AND records a fresh start balance.
- `log_trade_event` writes the connected login into every new `trade_logs` row.
- `get_trade_history` scopes its `trade_logs` enrichment query by current account.
- `get_state` returns `account_number` alongside balance/currency.

### UI
- Bridge panel shows `Connected · #<login>`; Tauri `StatusPayload` and `RawStatus` carry the new `account_number: Option<i64>` end-to-end.
